Plus, a dedicated Grow with Us area sharing the exciting development opportunities and training designed to support you to thrive and grow at Busy Bees.

  • Support the team in maintaining a safe and nurturing environment.
  • Help children develop socially, emotionally, and physically through engaging play-based learning.

Our hourly rates of pay differ for people under 21 but they are above national minimum wage levels. For employees aged 21 and above, our hourly rate of pay is £12.75.

As an Operational Support Grade, you will play a key part in supporting the day-to-day running of a busy prison. Electrical Maintenance Technician

Location: Gunstones Bakery, Dronfield

Shifts: 4 on 4 off pattern, 2 Days and 2 Nights

Salary: Competitive + Benefits

Join 2 Sisters Food Group, one of the UK's largest food manufacturers, with an annual turnover exceeding £3 billion and approximately 13,000 employees across 16 sites. We have a strong presence in poultry, chilled, and bakery food categories. We are looking for a Maintenance Engineer with an electrical bias. The work is split 50/50 between reactive and planned maintenance.

  • Fixing mixers, conveyors, packaging equipment

  • Supporting with machinery breakdowns as needed

Ideally, you will be an electrically qualified maintenance technician, with experience in fast-paced manufacturing environments. We are also open to candidates from different industries who are eager to progress their career.

Key Skills/Qualifications

  • Strong electrical skills
  • Experience in food production or a manufacturing environment.
  • Hands-on experience with NVQ Level 3 in electrical Engineering
  • Experience in a planned and reactive maintenance

Benefits

  • Refer a friend scheme
  • Health Assured Employee Assistance Programme and Grocery Aid are free and confidential support services 365 days a year
  • Boparan Restaurant Group Discount - 50% discount for friends and family. (Giraffe World Kitchen, Harry Ramsden, Ed's Easy Diner and Burger & Cocktails

As one of the UK's largest food manufacturers, we provide ample opportunities for career growth and skill development. We emphasise promoting from within, ensuring you can build a rewarding career with us.

By working in our network at one of our 39 schools, you will be directly making a positive impact on young people’s lives through high-quality teaching and thoughtful consideration of all backgrounds and needs, making educational equity a reality.

Ark Teacher Training (ATT) is a school-based programme offering the perfect mixture of theory and classroom practice to develop you into the best teacher you can be. Because we believe that every child, regardless of their background, deserves to have access to a great education, we work mainly in communities of lower income with a history of academic underachievement.
